name: Investment Analyst
description: Performs investment analysis across the Finance & Investments value stream, supporting security selection, portfolio valuation, and rebalancing within approved policy limits. Measures asset-liability duration gaps, projects policyholder liability cash flows, and monitors counterparty exposure. Maintains investment guideline compliance monitoring and delivers performance reporting to the CFO, ALCO, and investment committee.

name: Investment Operations Manager
description: Oversees investment operations within Finance & Investments, managing capital instruments, share repurchase programs, and financial statement preparation. Prepares statutory reserve schedules and calculates actuarial liability balances in coordination with the Actuarial value stream. Ensures actuarial data quality, reconciles claims and cost data, and supports financial examinations and M&A financial workstreams.

name: Investor Relations Director
description: Leads the investor and rating agency relations function within the Executive Office, shaping the company's equity story and communications with shareholders, analysts, and rating agencies. Coordinates earnings communications, rating agency reviews, and disclosure messaging in partnership with Finance and executive leadership.

name: Junior Developer
description: Performs engineering delivery work across the Technology & Engineering value stream, contributing to infrastructure-as-code, data pipeline CI/CD, and environment lifecycle management. Supports cybersecurity operations including secret rotation, certificate management, and cloud security posture reporting. Retires deprecated IaC modules, maintains Helm chart libraries, and enforces deployment standards for workload onboarding.

name: Lead Generation Analyst
description: Performs lead generation analytics for the Sales, Distribution & Marketing value stream, covering lead capture, scoring, routing, and nurturing. Designs segmented nurture journeys, defines qualification criteria by line of business, and instruments funnel-stage tracking for conversion optimization. Administers the CRM, manages its integrations, and records marketing consent and TCPA status for compliance.

name: Learning & Development Specialist
description: Performs learning and development delivery within the Human Resources & Talent value stream, building leadership development programs and SCORM-based learning content. Tracks certifications and reconciles credential registers, supports licensing, and generates mandatory training compliance attestations. Facilitates coaching engagements, schedules cohort workshops with external facilitators, and evaluates program impact against leadership KPIs.

name: Learning Development Manager
description: Leads learning program delivery within the Human Resources & Talent value stream, owning licensing support, learning content development, and mandatory training compliance. Publishes approved content to the LMS, assigns learning paths, and maps training requirements to regulatory frameworks. Tracks certifications and CE compliance, flags producers at risk of license lapse, and maintains content version control as regulations change.

name: Legal Counsel
description: Owns legal advisory work across the Legal & Corporate Governance value stream, spanning board meeting planning, entity licensing, and governance policy management. Manages regulatory filings, corporate governance annual disclosures, and legal records retention obligations. Handles complaint and dispute matters, adjudicates commission disputes, and supports enterprise risk oversight reporting across Business Operations, Finance, and HR.

name: Legal Operations Manager / Corporate Paralegal
description: Coordinates legal operations for the Legal & Corporate Governance value stream, supporting board meeting planning, secretarial filings, and legal entity administration. Manages regulatory filing workflows, responds to regulator objection letters, and negotiates resolutions with the DOI. Maintains director fee and equity award records, oversees political contributions compliance, and governs vendor data processing and contract financial obligations.

name: Legal Secretary
description: Administers legal support within the Legal & Corporate Governance value stream, managing regulatory filings, secretarial filings, and Holding Company Act compliance records. Monitors case timelines and court deadlines, coordinates status reviews with counsel, and maintains board composition records reported to regulators. Supports intellectual property management, PAC activity reporting, and the legal operations metrics dashboard.

name: Liability Claims Specialist
description: Performs liability claim handling within the Claims value stream, evaluating and documenting liability decisions and managing ongoing claim activity. Manages denials with follow-up for appeals, coordinates structured settlement placements, and administers release agreements. Monitors claims workflow routing exceptions, rebalances misrouted claims, and maintains vendor network directories, ordering IMEs or FCEs when evidence is insufficient.

name: Life Claims Examiner
description: Performs life claim examination within the Claims value stream, evaluating liability, documenting decisions, and managing claims through resolution on the claims platform. Handles denial management with appeal follow-up, structured settlement placement, and release agreement administration. Monitors workflow routing exceptions, rebalances misrouted claims, and maintains vendor networks, ordering independent examinations when evidence is insufficient.

name: Life Policy Service Representative
description: Performs policy operations service work within the Corporate Operations value stream, monitoring real-time workload against staffing and triggering load-balancing for queue imbalances. Supports vendor service management by escalating performance failures, driving remediation plans, and reviewing SOC 2 certifications. Pilots process improvements against baselines and contributes to workforce capacity planning and operations performance reporting.
